Nearly 12 acres, about five minutes from the Southworth ferry.

0 SE Sedgwick Road in Port Orchard is two parcels, 6.51 and 5.41 acres, both zoned Rural Residential. Level, usable ground for a custom home, a private estate or a small compound, with the room and privacy to build what you have in mind.

Quiet country living without the distance: the ferry for Seattle, West Seattle and Vashon Island, and minutes to shopping, dining and Highway 16.

Want to walk it? Send me a message and I’ll show you the parcels. Every photo is at homes.ranchpnw.com/sedgwick.

Chris Ranch · The Ranch Real Estate Group · (253) 335-5630
